content: Misa-sic bocyac
Yogolec lobeina Yesu ye Galili lifucka
mic-tengtengfocine hatacmac fikeyeledaicte. Yogowa yanguc fikewec,

Saimon Pita ailu Tomas, wacine monic Didimus wackelu gaibong. Ailu Natanael, ye Kana taonkacni, taon yogo Galili prowinswa fawec. Ailu Sebedi madeckecine, ailu Yesule mic-tengtengfocine 12 yengelacni ngic yaeckang, yenge momoc ngiyeibong.

Ngiyelu Saimon Pitadi agofocine yanguc edocebawec, “Na misawa sicte hikenogale ngagegabac.” Inguc edocebame yengi yanguc miibong, “Nonge gaholec momoc hikedabelengte.” Inguc milu yenge momoc gombawa felu hikelu gaibong. Ailu deboc iwa sic monic mi baibong.
Moc gabong mac saewec, aime Yesu ye lifuc mecina domawec. Domame yenge Yesudi domawec, yogo mi ngani-motoibong.
Aime Yesudi yanguc uwayelewec,

content.text: “Agofocne, ngenge sic monic bagabiyeng, me miyac?”

content: Mime yengi “miyac” miibong.
Inguc mibong yedi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngenge uficngineng gomba folewapec wickebong haume sic gocne badaingte.”

content: Inguc mime yenge ye miwec, yogo balaibelu uficngineng wickebong haume misa-sic bocyacbenangti uficka haubong, fuluckenogale aibibiyelu ufickolec hegileibong.

Aime mic-tengteng Yesudi yele kweleinedi angackelu gawec, yedi Pita yanguc edowec, “Yogo Sugucnedi hocne.” Inguc mime Saimon Pita ye yogo ngagelu soc sugu domawecte ngakpiine holelu gombawacni wintackelu lifucka haulu molickelu dingongka fewec.
Feme mic-tengtengfocine gocne yenge lifucka dingong bangkacne, dalicne miyac, 100 mitalesoc gaibongte, yenge gombawa domalu uficngineng misa-sickolec fuluckela fuluckela dingongka feibong.
Mecina felu nganibong bret gocne ailu misa-sic dacka faibong.
Aime Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngenge misa-sic gocne yakumac bagabiyeng, yogo bawelening.”

content: Aime Saimon Pita ye yeicnac gombawa felu ufic fuluckeme mecina fewec. Uficka misa-sic sugucne sugucnedi wakelu faibong, dzalengineng 153 yogolecsoc aiwec. Ailu sifu ufic mi lokewec.
Aime Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,
Inguc mime mic-tengtengfocine yenge hangocebame yengelacni monicti “Ga ma” milu mi uwacnoibong. Yogo Sugucnedi hocne, yenge inguc biyac ngageibong.
Aime Yesu ye dac emeina welelu bret balu yelewec. Ailu misa-sic inguchac balu yelewec.
Yesu ye homackacni gboliyelu fangkewec, dameng iwa mic-tengtengfocine fikeyeleme, alecine habackang aiwec.
Yesudi Pita basanangkewec
Aime nosing nobong motome, Yesudi Saimon Pita yanguc uwacnowec,

content.text: “Saimon Yoane madecine, ga nale kwelegonedi angac ngagegic, yogo alingfocgone yago yengele angac ewaligac, me?”

content: Inguc mime Pitadi miwec, “Oc, Sugucne, na kwelenedi gale angac ngagegabac, yogo biyac ngagegic.” Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc miwec,
Milu Yesu ye hatacmac mime alecine yaeckang aiwec,

content.text: “Saimon, Yoane madecine, ga kwelegonedi nale angac ngagegic, me?”

content: Mime Pitadi miwec, “Oc, Sugucne, na kwelenedi gale angac ngagegabac, yogo biyac ngagegic.” Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc miwec,
Milu Yesudi hatacmac uwacnome alecine habackang aiwec,

content.text: “Saimon, Yoane madecine, ga kwelegonedi nale angac ngagegic, me?”

content: Yesudi uwacnome alecine habackang aime, Pita ye ngageme umalemebac Yesu yanguc edowec, “Sugucne, ga wiyac sasawa ngageyackegic. Na kwelenedi gale angac ngagegabac, yogo biyac ngagegic.” Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: Foinac, ga soc-gboli galu geuctihac besac hefelu angacgone balaibelu hike-kwesic aicaigic. Aime ga hikecgu ngic sugucnebenang aidamecte, dameng iwa molegone bafangkeng, monicti hefegelelu mac mi hikenogale ngagegic, iwa bacgulu hike locgudaicte, yogo noinebenang edocgugabac.”

content: Pita ye homacina silic wenuc homalu Wapong wacine bafedaicte, Yesudi yogolec ngagelu miwec. Ailu edolu miwec,

Yesudi inguc mime, Pita ye hefaliyelu nganime, Yesudi mic-tengteng monicte kweleinedi angackelu gawec, yedi yeke balaibecepawec. Ngic balaibecepawec, yedi hocne molickelu nosing noibong, dameng iwa Yesule mondacka holelu madi mudockeme badaingte yogolec uwacnowec.
Aime Pitadi mic-tengteng yogo nganilu Yesu yanguc uwacnowec, “Sugucne, yela wenuc fikedaicte?”
Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Na angacnume ngama ye gaemewa hatacmac hefaliye kwesidacte, yogo gale wiyac miyac. Ga moc welelu balaibecnuc.”

content: Inguc mime ngic hae-gbafocine yengi ngagelu yanguc miibong, “Mic-tengteng yogo ye mi homadaicte.” Aime Yesu ye mi homanale ngagelu mi miwec, miyac. Ye yanguc sugu miwec,

content.text: “Na angacnume ngama ye gaemewa, hatacmac hefaliye kwesidacte, yogo gale wiyac miyac.”

content: Yowa moto-motoine
Yesudi mic-tengtenginele kweleinedi angackelu gawec, yogo na hocne. Na siduc yagolec mibasanang ailu mibe yegengkeme kwelengkeiba. Aime yowane yogo noine, yogo ngagegabeleng.
Yesu ye aibaba gocne bocyac aiwec. Aime ngagebe aibaba yogolec yowa sasawa hibiwa kwelengkedabongka, ibac himongtowa yagowa hibi yogo lolole sawaine monic mi fadec.

footnotes.text: Grik yowawa Galili lifuc, yogolec wacine monic Tiberias kwelengkewec.
